com.empline/tool-documentation.access: Requires OAuth docs:read consent. Staff guides additionally require current staff permissions.
com.empline/tool-documentation.effects: Read-only; access is checked against the current role without modifying documentation.
com.empline/tool-documentation.failures: Missing/insufficient consent produces HTTP 401/403; unavailable documents are omitted and invalid queries return a tool error.
com.empline/tool-documentation.notFor: Public-only questions do not need account access, and sign-in does not itself grant staff permissions.
com.empline/tool-documentation.purpose: Search documentation using the connected account's current permissions.
com.empline/tool-documentation.returns: Returns visible documents and cited passages with versions and review dates; query plus documentId narrows the search to that document.
com.empline/tool-documentation.useWhen: Use for account-restricted or staff guidance; omitting query returns the permission-filtered table of contents.

description: Search documentation using the connected account's current permissions. Use for account-restricted or staff guidance; omitting query returns the permission-filtered table of contents. documentId.description: Exact document id from the table of contents; omit to search all visible documents. With no query, returns that document.

limit.description: Maximum documentation results to return (1-20); defaults to 10.

query.description: Plain-text search words; omit for the table of contents, or combine with documentId to search within one document.
